<thought>To generate the precursors, I need the retrosynthetic template that forms a sulfonamide from a sulfonyl chloride and an aromatic amine (breaks an S‑Cl bond and forms an N‑S bond). Using that template on the target molecule will give two precursors: the corresponding phenyl‑sulfonyl chloride (with the fluorinated phenyl) and the aromatic amine (the aryl ring that is currently attached to the sulfonamide, with an NH₂ instead of the sulfonyl group). This yields a single possible combination of precursors.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"O=S(Cl)(c1ccc(F)cc1)=O\", \"Nc1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1\"]]</final_answer>
